gate.bar: phase shares agree with plan 15e within 10 points, or the difference is explained
gate.measured: standard air 63.5 % vs 63 % (within 0.5); fast tier within 10 points on every phase at 4 h (fire 48.4 vs 58, embers 14.9 vs 13, coupling 15.9 vs 11, air 0.0 vs 5) but not at 30 min (fire 25.9, embers 24.1, coupling 19.3)
gate.why: the fast tier's shares move with the size of the fire (664 cells burnt at 30 min, 8110 at 4 h); standard agrees at both durations
